svg.title: Database per Service: partial progress across local transactions
svg.desc: Inventory commits a two-unit local adjustment, leaving three available units. A later Orders transaction rejects an order with zero requested units, leaving no order row. Inventory remains at three. Direct cross-service SQL is denied; a real workflow must resolve partial progress through a service contract and explicit recovery.
svg.text: Private stores have local commit boundaries
The Inventory change is committed before the next transaction.
Orders transaction rejects its zero-unit instruction
No order row is written. Inventory remains at 3 units.
Recovery belongs to an explicit service workflow
Runtime SQL cannot bypass the other service’s private schema.
Separate commits do not supply an all-or-nothing business operation.
Arrow: execution order. This is a deliberate failure fixture, not checkout code.
